limitations: The classification concerns exact two-state-pair merging in the given classical deterministic two-letter automaton under unit symbol costs, not reset words for larger subsets. The odd-state pair graph appeared explicitly in Gusev 2014; the new claim is the full all-state shortest-word and multiplicity classification, and earlier implicit priority remains a risk.
